title: Start Classifying: Categorical Critics for LLM Reinforcement Learning

rs.key_step: critic scalar MSE换categorical softmax+Gaussian-smoothed target CE，decode期望给同一GAE/PPO。
rs.why_non_obvious: 分布只是优化surrogate；不把binary return误称scalar regression统计不合法，也不把actor变成distributional RL。
rs.trigger_condition: When sparse returns make critic optimization difficult, replace scalar regression with a smoothed categorical surrogate while preserving the scalar actor interface.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When sparse returns make critic optimization difficult, replace scalar regression with a smoothed categorical surrogate while preserving the scalar actor interface.

signatures.information: GAE bootstrap scalar target、fixed value support
signatures.operation: HL-Gauss target CE训练，V=sum_i p_i z_i
signatures.failure_boundary: 仅Qwen4–7B；校准/adv对称诊断不证明唯一因果中介；support与bandwidth需按reward选。

relevance.how: 可提升PPO critic/token advantage可靠性，但本流水线critic-free须改架构。
